goals.title: G001 Baseline and architecture contracts
goals.objective: Lock existing behavior and define validated runtime, presentation, capability, session, record, transport, and API contracts with architecture tests.

goals.title: G002 Product design system and application shell
goals.objective: Build the semantic design foundation and capability-driven product shell without changing workflow authority.

goals.title: G003 Domain registry and neutral orchestration
goals.objective: Introduce lazy-loaded app-local domain runtime and presentation registries plus a domain-neutral review controller.

goals.title: G004 Network workflow parity migration
goals.objective: Migrate the current network experience into the new workbench while preserving replay, gate, simulation, rollback, receipt, and red-team behavior.

goals.title: G005 Terraform external-diff workbench
goals.objective: Add a first-class Terraform review experience that honestly represents external-diff semantics and never implies simulation or execution.

goals.title: G006 Kubernetes simulated-state workbench
goals.objective: Add a first-class Kubernetes review experience using existing deterministic domain behavior and explicit capability-gated actions.

goals.title: G007 Runtime modes intake queue and receipt proof
goals.objective: Separate public replay from authenticated self-hosted review, add intake and review queue flows, and render receipt proof claims independently.

goals.title: G008 Policy coverage sources and future-domain template
goals.objective: Make domain and policy coverage visible and prove a fourth-domain registration path with a generic fallback; production IAM remains a separately specified post-vNext target.

goals.title: G009 Accessibility responsive performance and security hardening
goals.objective: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA targets, responsive workbench behavior, bounded bundle budgets, and existing secret and provenance controls.

goals.title: G010 Cutover documentation and final quality gate
goals.objective: Cut over the default experience, retire obsolete showcase paths, update documentation, and pass the full regression, build, E2E, corpus, gallery, and security gates.

codexObjective: Complete the durable ultragoal plan in .omx/ultragoal/goals.json, including later accepted/appended stories, under the original brief constraints; use .omx/ultragoal/ledger.jsonl as the audit trail.
